**Fact.** ∫xⁿ dx = x^{n+1}/(n+1) + C (n ≠ −1); ∫dx/x = ln|x| + C. Indefinite = family of antiderivatives.
**Fact.** Integration by parts: ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du (LIATE choice). Substitution: let t = g(x), adjust dx.
**Fact.** Definite integral = accumulation; area under y=f over [a,b] when f ≥ 0; area between curves = ∫|f−g| dx.
**Fact.** Fundamental theorem: d/dx ∫_a^x f(t)dt = f(x); ∫_a^b f = F(b) − F(a).
